description: Static implementation, machine gate, independent review, bounded repair, and human acceptance workflow.

nodes.instructions: Implement the supplied goal in the isolated worktree. Keep the change narrowly scoped and add or update focused tests. Do not merge, push, create a PR, or alter the canonical checkout.
acceptance: The requested behavior is implemented in the isolated worktree.
Changes stay within the goal and stated scope.
Focused tests are present where applicable.

nodes.instructions: Run the pre-approved focused test command without a shell.
Review the implementation in a fresh, read-only context. Assess the goal, acceptance criteria, diff, changed files, and machine evidence. Do not edit files. Report concrete structured findings only.
acceptance: Every goal acceptance criterion is met.
The implementation introduces no material correctness or scope defect.
Machine-gate evidence is sufficient for the claimed scope.

nodes.instructions: Repair only the latest machine-gate failures and reviewer findings supplied in EXACT_ALLOWED_REPAIR_SCOPE. Do not broaden the goal or touch unrelated files.
acceptance: All supplied failures/findings are addressed within the existing goal.
The candidate is ready to rerun the machine gate.

nodes.instructions: Stop and present the validated candidate for an explicit human verdict.
acceptance: A human explicitly accepts or rejects the candidate.
